reviewed_component: EDI implementation architecture: eight logical owners

criteria.rationale: Explicit mission/system/I7/appendix/retained/consumer requirements flow to implementation requirements, functions, owner contracts and prospective cases. Structural trace validation is separate from semantic or runtime proof.
One state owner per domain; all directed pairs and eleven facets specified at proposal level, with concrete schema/grammar obligations reserved for the contract gate.
Eight logical modules in one application; no service per concept, no compulsory framework cluster or newly trained world model. Conditional adoption triggers compare simpler options.
Independent role/basis/time/use axes, source and imported-model lineage, rival mechanisms, unknowns and original forecast integrity are explicit.

Finite proposed DEV1 admission/work budgets and a separately qualified future HA profile; complete costs, unknown usage, failures and offered-work denominators are retained. No measured performance asserted.
Staged artifact/metadata durability, local transactions/outbox, lease fencing, retention invalidation and composed feedback/failure analysis specify bounded recovery responsibilities.

Current provider catalogs, original model cards, official libraries/standards and original research support narrow capability claims. Preferences and representative older research are labeled; no exhaustive global SOTA ranking asserted.
Forty proposed cases, one initial integrated campaign and matched comparison controls are designed. Document checks and review-tool consistency never qualify runtime behavior or intelligence.

findings.description: Concrete record schemas, native-envelope compatibility, admission policy fixtures and first capability contract are not frozen.
Exact dependency/provider/checkpoint/license and OS/hardware compatibility pins require implementation binding.
Restricted numerical grammar, event/history semantics and backend capability fixtures must precede executable-analysis contract qualification.
Runtime capacity/recovery, causal discovery, transfer, intelligence advantage and HA remain unmeasured and unqualified.

Initial document check found its own not-yet-created output link missing. The checker now creates a pending output record before link validation; the original failure is retained in document-checks-initial.json. No product case or acceptance threshold was changed.

changes.description: New prospective implementation allocation and alternatives preserve the source snapshots and historical review statuses.

measurements.description: DEV1 and HA1 targets in VERIFICATION.md are not achieved values.

next_step: Review the proposal, then bind concrete typed contracts and one focused source/identity/time fixture for the first chosen capability; no runtime build started.
